//: VENTURES (GDD §17 businesses, §19 'smaller houses that control smaller things'). A venture is a house's property that is not land: founded in a system for `cost`, it pays `yield` per level and `flat` whatever its level, costs `upkeep` per level, can be expanded to `maxLevel` for `expandCost` a step, and pays `charter` credits per level each turn to whoever holds the planet there when that is another house. `requires` says where it can be founded. A lender's bank holds other houses' loans and takes their interest.

businesses.name: Skimmer Fleet
businesses.description: Ramscoops in a giant's upper clouds, run on contract. Fuel for whoever holds the paper, and a charter to whoever holds the world.

businesses.name: Enrichment Concern
businesses.description: Centrifuges behind a wall of guards. Weapons-grade isotopes do not reach the open market; they reach whoever owns this.

businesses.name: Trading Company
businesses.description: Factors, warehouses and a seal on the customs house. The first thing a house with coin and no land buys.

businesses.name: Mining Concern
businesses.description: Tugs, crushers and a company of belt-rats on contract. Works a belt without owning a claim in it.

businesses.name: Shipping Line
businesses.description: Hulls on the lanes under your colours. Where three lanes meet, everything pays to pass.

businesses.name: Merchant Bank
businesses.description: A counting-house with the house's seal on its door. Other houses' debts come here, and so does their interest.

businesses.name: Salvage Guild
businesses.description: Wreckers and scrap-smelters on a world nobody wanted. Now and then they bring up something stranger than steel.

businesses.name: Spice Syndicate
businesses.description: Licences, laboratories and a quiet arrangement with the archivists. Exotics by the gram, credits by the crate.

businesses.name: Free Company
businesses.description: Veterans under contract, paid by whoever is frightened this season. Costs you people; pays in coin.

businesses.name: Academy Patronage
businesses.description: Chairs endowed, cadets sponsored, names remembered. It earns nothing a steward can count and everything a chancellor can.

finance.//: The standing loan: borrow loanPrincipal, owe loanRepay, pay loanInstalment a turn whether the ledger can bear it or not. A belt claim costs claimCredits + claimMaterials. An investment spends investCredits for +investProsperity on a holding.
